name: mattpocock/skills (Matt Pocock)
hook: 81.5K stars, +6,400 in the past week — #1 weekly-trending AI repo on GitHub as of May 14. name: Anthropic Agent SDK Credits (June 15 policy change)
hook: Starting June 15, Anthropic splits Claude subscriptions: programmatic usage via the Agent SDK, `claude -p`, GitHub Actions, and third-party harnesses (OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, etc.) moves into a separate non-rollover monthly credit pool — Pro gets $20/mo, Max 5× gets $100, Max 20× gets $200. The move reverses an April 2026 ban on third-party agents that triggered widespread community backlash. To soften the transition, Anthropic also stacked a temporary +50% weekly Claude Code usage increase through July 13 (on top of the earlier 2× 5-hour limit doubling). HN thread topped 450+ comments.

name: Claude Code v2.1.141 (May 13)
hook: Released May 13 at 23:19 UTC. Four standout additions: (1) Rewind menu now includes "Summarize up to here" — creates a compressed snapshot of any past conversation state on demand; (2) `claude agents --cwd <path>` scopes the session list to a directory; (3) background agents now preserve the current permission mode instead of reverting to default; (4) MCP servers that hit transient startup errors auto-retry up to 3× before going dark. Also adds `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS` (clone plugins over HTTPS not SSH) and `ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID` env vars.

name: Mobbin MCP
hook: Launched May 13. Official MCP server from Mobbin giving Claude Code, Cursor, and Lovable direct access to 621,500+ real app screens and 142,200+ user flows from shipped production apps — fintech, e-commerce, health, productivity, social, and SaaS, including subscription-only and region-locked apps. name: awesome-design-md (VoltAgent)
hook: Still climbing past 76K stars. A curated collection of 73 DESIGN.md files, one per brand: Apple, Stripe, Uber, Anthropic/Claude, Tesla, Notion, Figma, Supabase, Linear, Spotify, NVIDIA, and 62 others. Each file is plain markdown describing colors, typography, spacing, and visual feel. Drop one into your project root and Claude generates a matching UI without any config or dependencies.

name: agent-skills (addyosmani)
hook: 40.2K stars. Addy Osmani (ex-Google Chrome DevRel, now at Anthropic) applied Google's production engineering discipline to Claude Code via 22 skills spanning the full dev lifecycle: DEFINE → PLAN → BUILD → VERIFY → REVIEW → SHIP. Standouts: spec-driven-development (writes spec before touching code), doubt-driven-development (forces agents to surface uncertainty explicitly), code-simplification (structural review after every build), and shipping-and-launch (pre-ship checklist with ADR generation). Cross-platform: Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Windsurf.

name: Playwright CLI (Microsoft)
hook: v0.1.13, 10.3K stars. Microsoft's token-efficient browser automation CLI purpose-built for coding agents. Playwright MCP streams full browser accessibility trees into the model's context window; Playwright CLI saves browser state to compact YAML files on disk instead. Microsoft's own benchmark: 114,000 tokens per session with MCP vs 27,000 tokens with CLI — 4× reduction. Works with Claude Code through the Bash tool exactly like git or npm.

name: caveman (JuliusBrussee)
hook: 57.4K+ stars. Skill that reduces output tokens 65–75% by instructing the model to drop articles, filler words, and pleasantries while keeping all technical substance. Four intensity levels: Lite, Full (default), Ultra, and Wenyan (Classical Chinese). Crossover signal: mattpocock/skills — the #1 trending repo this week — bundles caveman as a core technique, confirming its durability.

name: RTK — Rust Token Killer (rtk-ai)
hook: 45.5K+ stars. Single Rust binary that intercepts stdout from 100+ commands (git, npm, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, AWS CLI) and compresses it 60–90% before it reaches the model. A 45-line `ls` output (~800 tokens) becomes 12 lines (~150 tokens); `git push` shrinks from 200 tokens to 10 tokens. v0.39.0 shipped May 6; `rtk gain` shows cumulative savings.

name: last30days-skill (mvanhorn)
hook: 25.8K stars, v3.2.0 released May 10. Searches Reddit, X/Twitter, YouTube, TikTok, Hacker News, Polymarket, GitHub, and the open web simultaneously — scoring results by real engagement metrics (upvotes, views, prediction-market odds) rather than editorial algorithms — then synthesizes a single grounded brief with citations. As the creator puts it: "Google aggregates editors. /last30days searches people." Works in Claude Code, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, and claude.ai web.

name: MCP OAuth Token Theft — Mitiga Research
hook: Mitiga Labs disclosed an attack chain that silently steals Claude Code's OAuth tokens via malicious npm packages. A postinstall hook rewrites `~/.claude.json` to redirect MCP traffic through an attacker-controlled proxy; persistence survives token rotations by re-writing the config on next load. Reported to Anthropic April 10; Anthropic replied April 12 that it was 'out of scope'. No fix shipped. Mitigation: audit `~/.claude.json` for unexpected MCP URLs before any npm install.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 3 — still no fix from Anthropic; audit ~/.claude.json MCP entries
